_about: Local deployment settings. Set SOMESH_ADMIN_PIN or security.admin_pin privately; no default password is supplied.

network._about: Shared office (LAN) access. allowed_networks: only these client addresses may use the app (default: this PC and private office ranges, never the internet). session_days: sign-ins expire after this many days (0 = never). public_url: the address to show and to put in email links, e.g. https://192.168.1.20:8443. https: run tools/make_office_cert.py first; redirect_lan_http sends other PCs from http:8080 to https once every employee PC trusts office-ca.crt. allowed_origins: extra web origins allowed to POST (normally empty).

lunch._about: Lunch break: not counted in task timers, and the app is locked for everyone except admins. Change it from the Tracker page.

workday._about: Working hours used by the Dashboard for utilisation and idle gaps. days: 0 = Monday ... 5 = Saturday.

task_templates.name: Scan and upload documents
task_templates.about: Scan the papers given and upload them as PDF.

task_templates.name: Data entry in master tracker
task_templates.about: Enter the day's bills and payments in the Master Tracker.

task_templates.name: File physical copies
task_templates.about: Sort and file the paper copies in the right box or cabinet.

task_templates.name: Photocopy and bind bill set
task_templates.about: Copy, bind and label the bill set for delivery.

task_templates.name: Courier dispatch
task_templates.about: Book the courier, hand over, upload the receipt.

task_templates.name: Follow-up call to client
task_templates.about: Call the client about payment or pending papers; note the outcome.

task_templates.name: Update attendance register
task_templates.about: Bring the attendance register up to date from the latest sheets.

task_templates.name: Email daily report
task_templates.about: Send the day's summary report to the lead.

workflow_input._about: Set from the app (Workflow input page). location = Google Sheet link or file path. auto_reload_minutes = re-read it every N minutes (0 = only when you press Apply).

storage._about: Data Center storage: Master Tracker, Contract Register and Vault. root = 'storage' (the storage folder in the project root, next to the .bat file) or a full path such as G:\\Shared drives\\Data Center\\SOMESH Storage. Restart after changing.

automation._about: Set from the app's Automation page (admins).

gather._about: Gather 2.0 Smart Objects. Place an Inbox (or a Signal light) in Gather, open its menu, copy the Webhook URL and secret (whsec_...) here. dept = show that department's open tasks; person = show one person's own tasks. Then run: python app.py --gather-test
